title: eo-claim-lint report
description: The findings of one linting run. 'valid' is derived from the issues and is never supplied by the caller.

valid.description: False when at least one issue has error severity. Warnings and info alone leave a report valid.

rule_id.description: EOC0xx document contract, EOC1xx observation and estimate separation, EOC2xx claim safety, EOC3xx provenance and evidence, EOC4xx data origin and processing. Rule ids are never reused.

path.description: JSONPath-like location within the checked document. Full JSONPath conformance is not guaranteed.

doc_url.description: Documentation for the rule. Null until the rule pages exist; a URL is never fabricated.

context.description: Machine-readable detail about this issue. Must not carry the checked document in full, nor any credential or personal data.
